ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in the Western US changed by +0.27 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.12 to +0.43), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.67 °C.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Western US shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.40): the estimate is −0.009 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.029 to +0.011). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
